Principle of Conservation of Energy
Energy can neither be created nor can be destroyed: Only energy can be
transformed from one form to another form. Whenever energy is utilized in
one form; equal amount of energy is produced in other form. Hence total
energy of the universe always remains the same: This is called the principle
of conservation of energy
